sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of malarial conditions and digestive disorders. It is useful in cases of chronic diarrhoea and dysentery. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of low-grade fevers.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach.
sections.Abdomen: Distended and tender. Chronic diarrhoea of thin, watery stools. Dysentery.
sections.Stool: Thin, watery, and foul-smelling. Bloody mucus.
